```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "../scripts")
from theme import ESPRIT, base_layout, evolution_bar, evolution_cumul

from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True)

rap = pd.read_csv("../data/rapporteurs.csv")
for c in rap.select_dtypes(include="object").columns:
    rap[c] = rap[c].astype(str).str.strip()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

n_total = len(rap)
n_etudiants = rap[["nom", "prenom"]].drop_duplicates().shape[0]
n_soutenus = rap["statut"].str.contains("Soutenu|Terminé", na=False).sum()
n_encours = (rap["statut"] == "En cours").sum()

print(f'''
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:0.8rem;margin:1rem 0;">
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_total}</span><span class="label">Rapports évalués</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_etudiants}</span><span class="label">Étudiants</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_soutenus}</span><span class="label">Soutenus</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_encours}</span><span class="label">En cours</span></div>
</div>
''')
```

## Évolution temporelle

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

evolution_bar(rap, "Rapports évalués par année et niveau",
              [ESPRIT[5], ESPRIT[8], ESPRIT[1]]).show()
evolution_cumul(rap, "Rapports évalués cumulés au fil des années",
                "#6A1B9A", "rgba(106,27,154,0.08)").show()
```

## Répartitions

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

# Bar horizontal par formation
fc = rap["formation"].value_counts().reset_index()
fc.columns = ["formation", "count"]
fig = px.bar(fc.sort_values("count"), x="count", y="formation", orientation="h", text="count",
              title="Rapports évalués par formation",
              color="count", color_continuous_scale=[[0, "#F3E5F5"], [1, "#6A1B9A"]])
fig.update_traces(textposition="outside")
fig.update_layout(coloraxis_showscale=False)
base_layout(fig)
fig.show()

# Donut par niveau
nc = rap["niveau"].str.strip().value_counts().reset_index()
nc.columns = ["niveau", "count"]
fig = px.pie(nc, names="niveau", values="count", hole=0.55,
              color_discrete_sequence=[ESPRIT[3], ESPRIT[4], ESPRIT[1]],
              title="Répartition par niveau")
fig.update_traces(textposition="outside", textinfo="label+percent+value")
base_layout(fig)
fig.show()
```
